description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and constants related to resource quota evaluation and statistics in Kubernetes, including Evaluator, Configuration, Registry interfaces, and related types.

classes.name: UsageStatsOptions
classes.description: Options for calculating resource usage statistics, including namespace, scopes, resources, and scope selector.

classes.name: UsageStats
classes.description: Represents the result of resource usage measurement, mapping resources to quantities used.

classes.name: Evaluator
classes.description: Interface for evaluating quota usage for a specific group resource, including methods for constraints, matching, usage, and statistics.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Interface defining quota system configuration, including ignored resources and evaluators.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Interface for maintaining a list of Evaluator instances, allowing addition, removal, and retrieval.

classes.name: ListerForResourceFunc
classes.description: Function type for obtaining a lister for a specific resource.

methods.name: Constraints
methods.description: Ensures that required resources are present on the given runtime object.

methods.name: GroupResource
methods.description: Returns the group and resource that the evaluator knows how to evaluate.

methods.name: Handles
methods.description: Determines if quota could be impacted by the specified admission attributes.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if a quota matches the input item.

methods.name: MatchingScopes
methods.description: Returns the set of scopes that match the input object.

methods.name: UncoveredQuotaScopes
methods.description: Returns quota scopes that are limited but not covered by existing quota scopes.

methods.name: MatchingResources
methods.description: Returns the set of resources that the evaluator matches.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Returns resource usage for a specific object.

methods.name: UsageStats
methods.description: Calculates the latest observed usage statistics for all objects.

methods.name: Evaluators
methods.description: Returns the list of evaluators used in quota evaluation.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an evaluator to the registry.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an evaluator from the registry.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an evaluator for a specific group resource.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all evaluators in the registry.

methods.name: ListerForResourceFunc
methods.description: Function type for obtaining a generic lister for a resource.
